Meier et al.2013, G02202 Version2 DOI10.7265/N55M63M1. Source monthly unedited CDR concentration, flags, projection and license; exact18files pinned locally.
Peng et al.2013 NOAA/NSIDC CDR algorithms, monthly concentrations, quality limitations and reproducibility.
Official NOAA NCEI v02r00 monthly files: July-December2013/2014 and January/March/June2014/2015. SHA256 pins in data/science/earth_expansion/seaice_sources.json.

limitations: Historical NOAA/NSIDC G02202 v02r00 observational adaptation, not the original IceNet OSISAF dataset or full-paper score reproduction.
Six fixed public chronological development cases at1/3/6-month leads; independent generalization requires frozen candidates and unseen years.
Version2 is superseded and is not current operational data. Satellite retrieval and summer melt uncertainty remain; pole-hole, land/coastal and missing cells are excluded.
Only valid Arctic ocean north of60N is scored; historical invalid cells have explicit masked zero placeholders. Edge diagnostic uses projected, not great-circle, distances.

requirements.datasets: 18 pinned official NOAA/NSIDC monthly satellite CDR files(~67MB), prepared E08 source bundle(~61MB), six forecasts on full native448x304 maps.
